title: U-Net Mars O2+ Beams: inference code, trained model, and beam interval catalog
description:
U-Net v11 inference software, trained model weights, and a curated catalog of 14,484 energetic O2+ beam intervals identified in MAVEN STATIC observations. This release supports the manuscript Deep-Learning Identification and Global Characterization of Energetic O2+ Beams at Mars (JGR: Planets, submission 2026JE010251).

The repository includes a reproducible 20 January 2018 example, preprocessing and inference documentation, and a model card. The interval catalog lists UTC start and end times and differs from raw network output. It does not contain the full sample-level moment dataset or all figure source data.
